html:
SMTO-CMP-0014 — SMTO needs to read the full result before finishing

GUID: 181a94a3-ffaa-4fae-ac3c-16735fcdb737
Slug: completion-incomplete-observation
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI model tried to finish the task right after a step whose output was cut short. SMTO wants the full output read first. The step itself already ran, and its result is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the task's last step to see the output that was cut short. This shows which result SMTO still needs to read in full before it can finish.
  2. If the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. SMTO reads the saved output instead of running the step again.
  3. If you've already checked the full result yourself, you can turn off "Enforce this check for this run" on the check card under the task. SMTO then accepts the shortened result for this task only, without running anything again.
  4. Don't select Restart task for this problem. Restart begins a fresh attempt and doesn't undo earlier actions, so changes could happen twice.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed and its reply reflects the whole result.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the task; the step already ran and running it again could repeat its effect.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Direct completion found the cited result missing observation_complete or carrying tool-truncated output, so the observation was not complete enough to finish from (reason incomplete_observation).

What this means

  • Direct completion observes missing observation_complete or tool-truncated output in the result/receipt. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Direct completion observes missing observation_complete or tool-truncated output in the result/receipt.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect retained output completeness and available bounded continuation/artifact references.

How to fix it

  • Check observation_complete and tool truncation on the result and receipt (attempt_direct_completion validate in src/agent_runtime/native/direct_completion.py). Resume so the model reads the remaining saved output through its continuation or artifact reference and then calls finish_task; do not rerun the effectful operation. The completion.complete_observation Agent Check controls enforcement.
  • Read the remaining bounded observation before making a complete claim.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The remaining original observation is retrieved without rerunning the effectful operation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
